facts.business: Zenith Steel Pipes & Industries Limited manufactures steel pipes and operates units in Khopoli, Murbad, Tarapur, and Trichy.

auditor.name: M/S. D E V A M & ASSOCIATES LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (1) Non-compliance with Section 74 of Companies Act, 2013 regarding public deposits; (2) Trade payables, receivables, loans, advances, deposits, intergroup balances, current liabilities, borrowings subject to reconciliation and confirmation; (3) Provision of Rs. 41.07 lakhs for non-operative frozen bank accounts without confirmations; (4) Material uncertainty on going concern as accumulated losses exceed share capital and reserves, net worth fully eroded; (5) Inventories valued at Rs. 594.51 lakhs without adequate supporting documentation for quantities, condition, and cost allocation.

key_risks: Non-compliance with public deposit regulations under Companies Act, 2013
Unreconciled and unconfirmed balances for trade payables, receivables, loans, advances, deposits, intergroup balances, current liabilities, borrowings
Non-operative bank accounts frozen by regulatory authorities
Material uncertainty on going concern due to fully eroded net worth
Inventory valuation lacks adequate supporting documentation
